{"CommandLine":"$csc = "C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe"
$src = "c:\Users\andre\OneDrive\Desktop\xview\programa perfecto\1_HERRAMIENTAS_MOTOR\ProgramaPerfecto.cs"

& "c:\Users\andre\OneDrive\Desktop\xview\programa perfecto\1_HERRAMIENTAS_MOTOR\adb.exe" disconnect | Out-Null

$workDir = "c:\Users\andre\OneDrive\Desktop\xview\programa perfecto"
$logFile = "c:\Users\andre\OneDrive\Desktop\xview\programa perfecto\BITACORA_EN_VIVO_EXE.log"

$psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
$psi.FileName = $out
$psi.WorkingDirectory = $workDir
$psi.UseShellExecute = $true
$psi.WindowStyle = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessWindowStyle]::Normal
$p = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)

Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Write-Host "[VENTANA ABIERTA EN LINEA] PID=$($p.Id)"

$lastLen = 0
if (Test-Path $logFile) { $lastLen = [Math]::Max(0, (Get-Item $logFile).Length - 1400) }

while ($true) {
    if (Test-Path $logFile) {
        $item = Get-Item $logFile
        if ($item.Length -gt $lastLen) {
            $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($logFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
            $fs.Seek($lastLen, [System.IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin) | Out-Null
            $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($fs, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
            $newText = $sr.ReadToEnd()
            $sr.Close()
            $fs.Close()
            $lastLen = $item.Length
            if ($newText) { Write-Host -NoNewline $newText }
        }
    }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350
}","IsDaemon":true,"WaitMsBeforeAsync":4000,"toolSummary":"Compile and launch Programa Perfecto window in real time and monitor live"}
